title: Tool speed and cache hygiene: eval three times faster, check-trailers in one git log, _cache pruned
goal: rag.py eval over its 574 rows makes under 2,000 _load_own calls and prints the same results, so the run takes about a third of today's 6.3 s; check-trailers over a range of N commits makes at most 6 git calls, not three per commit; a clone's _cache keeps only live pack index files (other root sets' pruned after a stated period) and a unit cache that reclaims its pruned rows' space, proven by a test within the ceiling; the tool-speed rows for rag.py eval and check-trailers in benchmarks.md are re-recorded.
